answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 38 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The mesa debit happens at intake, quartz totals the burned amount, and beacon anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm as a result pays the burn once for each extra identity on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. That is 36 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
